{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'

print(f"Revenue dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}")

print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {(df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()}")

# Check status
print(f"Unique values in status: {df['status'].unique()}")

# Check channel
print(f"Channel distribution: {df['channel'].value_counts().to_dict()}")
